name: Chongqing Baiya Sanitary Products Co., Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Baiya Sanitary Products Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of disposable personal hygiene products in China. The company offers sanitary napkins, panty liners, baby diapers, and adult incontinence products under the Free Point, Haozhi, and Danning brands. It also provides business management consulting services. The company sells its products to distributors, OEM clients, shopping malls, and supermarkets, as well as through e-commerce platforms. Chongqing Baiya Sanitary Products Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Chongqing, China.
